title: SRE weekly ops sync - 2026-03-21 (draft)
content:
Agenda (30m)
- Quick status + wins (3m)
  - No regional degradations last week; rollout success for redis-cluster fix (20% traffic on dedicated pool).
  - Reduced avg cold-start time for embeddings service by ~15% after pre-warm patch.
- SLO snapshot & trends (7m)\  - Availability SLO: 99.95% target (global). Last 7d: 99.93% (slightly under).
  - Error budget burn: 0.02% used in last 7d, triggered review for paging spike on 3/18.
  - Latency SLOs: generation p95 < 300ms, p99 < 700ms. Last 7d p99: 680ms (close to threshold during peak).
  - Embeddings service p99: 450ms (improved).
- Paging trends (5m)\  - Total pages last week: 6 (vs 2 prior week).
  - Pager root cause distribution: model OOMs (3), upstream auth flaps (2), infra autoscaler oscillation (1).
  - Trend: model OOM pages cluster around longer context runs from customer X (tickets: INC-4321).
- Top incidents + RCA highlights (10m)\  - INC-4321 (3/18): memory OOM on rending-hosts during long-context user sessions -> RCA: model KV cache growth + prefetch bug. Mitigation: revert prefetch and bump pod memory; longer-term: KV cache cap + telemetry (owner: Marcus).
  - INC-4319 (3/16): auth token refresh errors causing 502s for hosted-api -> RCA: race in token refresher library under load. Mitigation: hotfix merged (PR 214), rollout to canary complete; need full rollout + post-rollout checks (owner: Aisha).
  - INC-4305 (3/14): autoscaler flapping on dedicated pool during burst tests -> note: policy thresholds too tight. Action: adjust scale-down grace period to 90s (owner: Samira).
- Action items / follow-ups (recorded here for tracking)\  1) Marcus: implement KV cache hard cap + telemetry for long contexts; PR + test by 2026-04-02. Linked: INC-4321.
  2) Aisha: complete full rollout of token refresher fix to all regions and run two peak-hour smoke tests; due 2026-03-24. Linked PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/214.
  3) Samira: update autoscaler policy (scale-down grace = 90s) and schedule canary; due 2026-03-23.
  4) Olivia: compose postmortem draft for INC-4321 and share w/ oncall rotation; due 2026-03-25.
  5) Team: add a prompt-set driven perf test for long-context workloads to CI (owner: Marcus + infra); spec by 2026-03-28.
- Notes / open questions (parking lot)\  - Do we want to limit max context for hosted tiers as temporary mitigation? Pros/cons to discuss with product.
  - Need cost estimate for increasing memory for rending-hosts fleet vs. engineering effort to implement cache cap. Finance sync? (tagging product/finance).
  - Paging noise: consider lowering paging sensitivity for single 5m blips that self-heal; risk: missing real issues.
- Quick wins for next 2 weeks\  - Add KV cache size metric to Grafana dashboard (Marcus)
  - Add scheduled smoke tests for token refresh under load (Aisha)
  - Update runbook entry for long-context OOMs with mitigation steps + contact list (Samira)
Useful links / refs\- Postmortem template: CONF-7892
- PagerDuty: team-oncall schedule link (slack pinned)
- Related tickets: INC-4321, INC-4319
Meeting prep for oncall rotation this week\- Oncall: Marcus (primary), Aisha (secondary). Marcus to highlight current mitigations in Slack 15m before handover.
Draft messages\- Slack: "Heads up: working on KV cache cap to address recent OOM pages; expect short deploy next Tue (Mar 24)."
- Customer comms: draft short note for customer X re: longer-context instability (keep high-level, no internal RCA).
